description: Multi-dimensional evidence ledger for the Time Series Agent survey
module_level_unit: One source-grounded module ID counts once at its assigned layer, independently of its dimension/task labels. Background and blocked records contribute zero.

module_level_fields.general_ts_harness: Five dimensions plus one or more temporal functions
module_level_fields.task_specific: Task contracts indexed by the same five mechanism dimensions, including explicit additional task values

maintenance_source: paper_classification_ledger.csv; reviewed_modules_json is preserved during sync
additional_task_values: other_tasks extends the existing task coordinate; it does not create another taxonomy.

temporal_function_view.description: Non-exclusive Section 5 reading view over the same module records, not a replacement for the five dimensions or scope. Task membership does not determine module scope.
temporal_function_view.counting: Unique module id, regardless of functions or task memberships.

version_policy: The schema version covers both record fields and controlled vocabulary. Maintained rows and all generators read this version; historical review files retain their original annotations. Version 3.0 (2026-11-07 re-audit) replaces the seven dimensions with five, retires the old labels, and adds role_of_work, evaluation_evidence, task_impact and module functions, view_status, llm_route, rubric_path and confidence.

official_resources.description: Source-attributed external links; no implementation is copied or packaged. Availability is independent of authorship provenance.
official_resources.absence: not_found_in_source means no attributed resource was located in the inspected source, not that none exists.

agent_terminology: claimed_as_agent records use of Agent terminology for the system or its components; agent_claim_evidence retains the basis.

levels.demonstrated: The source applies the module to two or more task families: those recorded for the module, or for the work when the module has none.
levels.inferred: The source applies the module to one task family; reuse across tasks is inferred from its inputs, state, and interface.
levels.not_applicable: LLM-side and Task-Specific Harness modules, whose scope is model-side or bound to a task objective.

fields.tasks: Canonical task families on which the source applies the module.
fields.basis: module or work: where the task families were recorded.

reuse_evidence.review: Recorded per module by the adjudicated re-audit (rubric R8); the schema migration fills it only when absent.

retired_dimensions.Control, Verification, and Feedback: Planning and Orchestration when it controls or checks execution within an episode; Optimization and Evolution when feedback updates reusable assets across episodes (decided from the source, rubric R4).

roles_of_work.llm_side_technique: Supplies temporal encoding, understanding, reasoning, or prediction to the LLM.
roles_of_work.fixed_workflow: Executes a predetermined sequence of model and tool calls; returned outputs do not change which action comes next.
roles_of_work.feedback_driven_agent: Selects or revises subsequent actions according to observations returned by tools or environments.
roles_of_work.resource: Benchmark, environment, workbench, dataset or infrastructure that evaluates or hosts Time Series Agents.
roles_of_work.background: Relevant context but contributes no module of its own.

evaluation_criteria.process_validity: Did the runtime execute the intended operations and handle failures?
evaluation_criteria.temporal_validity: Did the system preserve the data window, numerical meaning and information availability?

work_level_fields.claim_evidence: List of {locator, quote} supporting the claim summary.
work_level_fields.evaluation_evidence: For each evaluation criterion: {present, locator, quote}; present is true only with a quote from the work's own experiments (rubric R10).
work_level_fields.task_impact: Reserved for rubric R11 task-impact records; empty until imported with scripts/apply_reaudit.py --impact.

evidence_locators.pdf_page: "PDF p.X; source text L<n>": page of the local PDF that contains the quote; L<n> is the line in the re-audit packet.
evidence_locators.packet_line: "Source text L<n>": line in the re-audit packet when no PDF page was found (repository sources, or a quote not located on a page).

task_group_second_level.description: Second-level tasks of the four task groups (scripts/task_groups.py); manuscript Table tab:tsk-vocab.

second_level_note: Second-level classes are a reading structure of the manuscript (Tables tab:component-vocab, tab:gts-vocab, tab:tsk-vocab); module records carry first-level labels only.

task_grid.description: Output mode x time relative to the current time (scripts/task_groups.py CELL, --grid). Mode by how the output is checked: regression (numeric target), classification (discrete target), generation (no single target: text or new series), decision (an action, judged by consequences). Time: before = the output describes the observed record I_tau; after = the quantity becomes observable after tau.
